name: Aidan Morrison
professional_summary: Reliable and customer-focused professional with nearly three years of experience in fast-paced customer service at Domino’s Pizza Porirua. Brings strong hands-on knowledge of tools, DIY projects, hardware products, low-voltage electronics, and IT systems. Confident assisting customers, explaining product use, following health and safety procedures, and working efficiently as part of a team. Highly motivated to contribute practical skills, product knowledge, and a strong work ethic.

education.qualification: New Zealand Diploma in Client Support and IT (Level 5)
education.description: Customer support and professional communication, IT troubleshooting and technical problem-solving, Computer systems, software, and networking fundamentals.

skills.description: Troubleshooting computer hardware/software, CAD design for prototyping, home automation setup/maintenance, analytical thinking, and documentation.
Experience with speakers, PCBs, and low-voltage electronics. Ability to follow wiring diagrams, schematics, and technical instructions.
Confident use of hand/power tools, furniture assembly, accurate measuring, cutting, fastening, and understanding of construction methods.
Customer service, retail sales support, de-escalation, and technical-to-layman translation.
Consistent adherence to workplace safety, safe tool handling, and maintaining organized, hazard-free work areas.

experience.description: Delivered orders efficiently while meeting strict time targets. Provided professional customer service, handled cash/EFTPOS, and assisted with in-store preparation, cleaning, and support tasks. Demonstrated reliability and commitment through long-term employment.
Provided consistent, friendly customer service during deliveries. Worked efficiently under pressure to meet delivery time targets. Followed strict health, safety, and road safety procedures.

additional_info.interests: Strong personal interest in DIY, tools, hardware, and building projects.
additional_info.availability: Flexible availability including weekends and public holidays.
additional_info.learning_attitude: Willing and quick to learn Mitre 10 systems and product ranges.
